description: This file defines the InputLayoutCache class responsible for building and caching Direct3D 11 input layouts within the ANGLE graphics library. It includes methods for creating input layouts based on vertex attributes, managing a cache of layouts, and handling special cases like instanced point sprite emulation.

classes.name: PackedAttribute
classes.description: A structure representing a packed vertex attribute with type, semantic index, format, padding, and divisor.

classes.name: PackedAttributeLayout
classes.description: A class managing a layout of packed vertex attributes, including methods to add attributes and compare layouts.

classes.name: InputLayoutCache
classes.description: A class that caches D3D11 input layouts to optimize rendering performance.

methods.name: addAttributeData
methods.description: Adds attribute data to the layout, encoding type, semantic index, format, and divisor.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two PackedAttributeLayout instances for equality.

methods.name: getInputLayout
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached input layout based on current vertex attributes and rendering state.

methods.name: createInputLayout
methods.description: Creates a new input layout resource for given vertex attributes and shader, used when cache miss occurs.

methods.name: setCacheSize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the input layout cache, clearing it if necessary.
